description: S3-3HDM quark sector with soft S3 breaking (mu5 = mu4 ansatz). Exact S3 forces |r| = |v1/v2| = sqrt(3) and V_us = 0; releasing r reproduces the observed six quark masses AND all three targeted CKM magnitudes |V_us|, |V_cb|, |V_ub| simultaneously, to numerical precision. The CP phase (and hence the full unitarity triangle) stays out of reach: this sector's Yukawas are real, so its CKM matrix is real and the Jarlskog invariant is exactly zero. With 9 parameters against 9 targeted observables the system is exactly determined, and the least-squares scan finds several distinct exact (cost~0) solutions at different r depending on the restart seed -- quote r and V_abs here as an existence proof of the mechanism, not a prediction; see finding 6 of notebook 02 and NOTES.md finding 9. Every exact solution found is listed under exact_solutions_r; the one recorded here is selected by a stated rule, the |r| closest to the exact-S3 value sqrt3.
selection: closest |r| to sqrt3 among exact solutions (cost < 1e-20)
